title: Vectors: RPL message signature verification
close_reason: Already covered. dao_origin_signature.json (50+ vectors) tests DAO origin signatures, schnorr48.json tests the crypto algorithm, link_frame.json tests signed frames, ccp_beacon_sig_gate.json tests L2 signature gating.
